notes.title: DLC - Hazard Perception Gamemode (19th-December)
notes.notes:
Throughout a vessel's lifetime, there are a variety of hazards the crew may experience and have to deal with. This can include treating infestations, faulty equipment and misplaced items. These contribute to unnecessary accidents and general disorder which impacts a crew's efficiency. Below is an example which contain such hazards.

[img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/27679570275056348/08A034620FFD608EBAE8C979BBE153683C727991/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img]

This DLC adds the new [b]'Hazard Perception'[/b] game mode; helping to train your skills in identifying potential dangers whilst onboard a ship. 

Take care in dealing with each scenario appropriately, whilst ensuring your ship is following modern safety standards. Be quick, however, as the inspector is on their way and you can't afford to be caught with an unseaworthy vessel.

[b][list]
[*]4 separate hazard levels spread over the ship
[*]over 35 unique hazards to be found
[*]Multiple ways to resolve and fix each hazard
[/list][/b]

We hope you enjoy this DLC upon its release on the 19th of December and as always we welcome your feedback. For any queries please use the community hub or contact us at our linked social accounts.

Thanks,
[b]- Onboard Maritime Team[/b]

notes.title: Update - 2nd October 2024
notes.notes:
[b]Time Trial Changes[/b]
We've been busy making some changes and additions to the first gamemode of Virtual Training Ship - 'Time Trial'. We felt this gamemode needed some more challenge and extra enviromental details to help elevate it and make it more engaging for the player.

[b]Winnie[/b]
You're no longer the sole occupier of the house, as Winnie the dog will now follow you around the ground floor. Can you persist with her begging, or will you find her a treat to buy yourself some peace whilst you hunt down the remaining items? 

[b]Safe Puzzle[/b]
We've also added a safe puzzle to solve, the player must find the code and interact with the safes keypad to unlock it and access their passport. 

Alongside this we've added some more models and sound effects to the house to help make it feel more lived in. We hope you enjoy this update and as always welcome your feedback.

Best regards,
[b]- Onboard Maritime Team[/b]

notes.title: Roadmap Announcement
notes.notes:
A big thanks to all who have bought a copy of Virtual Training Ship so early after its initial release! We really hope you're enjoying the game and having fun learning about the different equipment and scenarios found on a vessel.

We are eager to share with you our plans for the game with a roadmap looking at the future and into 2025.

[b]December – Hazard Perception 2024[/b]

A short game mode where the player attempts to identify hazards found on different levels of the ship. Can you identify and repair them all before the inspector arrives?

[b]January – Rules of the Road 2025[/b]

An extensive scenario which instructs the player how to avoid a collision at sea. This DLC will feature multiple new missions and custom animations including a flag identification game.

[b]March – Tank Inspection 2025[/b]

Enter the claustrophobic interior of the ship’s tanks. See if you can identify any hazards within them and work on treating and refurbishing the tanks internal walls.

[b]April – Enclosed Space 2025[/b]

An enclosed space is an area on a vessel which is not used for day-to-day activity but still needs to be entered occasionally. It is an extremely dangerous area which can result in injury and death if not handled appropriately. This DLC will walk the user through the correct steps required to safely enter and work in an enclosed space which is vital and important for the safety of everyone onboard. 

Please continue to give us feedback and reviews which will greatly help improve our game. For any queries please use the community hub or contact us at our linked social accounts.

Thanks again,
[b]- Onboard Maritime Team[/b]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Release Date[/b]
We are excited to announce the release date of our game Virtual Training Ship (LITE), which will go live on the 7th of September.

[b]About our game[/b]
Virtual Training ship (LITE) is an educational game designed for maritime professionals, maritime colleges, academies and those curious about life at sea on a modern ship. The game in its current form will feature three game modes representing different scenarios found on a vessel.

We've spent the last few weeks polishing our game and preparing for its imminent release. Below is some of the content which will be included in Virtual Training Ships' initial release.

[b]Time Trial[/b]
Gather all the correct documentation to show you are properly qualified and prepared before you join your ship. You must complete this quickly under a strict time limit before you miss your departure flight!

[b]Free Roam[/b]
Board and make yourself familiar with your ship as you explore the deck and engine room. The game contains 'over 50 detailed info boxes' written by maritime professionals that give you a description of some of the critical equipment you will find on a modern vessel. See if you can find them all!

[b]Realistic Interactive Boiler[/b]
Complete the challenge of carrying out maintenance of the ship’s boiler under the watchful eye of one of the engineering officers!

In closing, we hope you enjoy our game and find it to be a valuable, educational tool. Please wishlist our game if interested. For any queries please use the community hub or contact us at our linked social accounts. 

Thanks,
[b]- Onboard Maritime Team[/b]
